translations.web: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
translations.bsb: Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.
translations.kjv: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
